verdict.rationale: mParticle documents forwarding/integration of customer data to hundreds of downstream vendors and warehouses (docs-25, docs-27, docs-x4), which implies some data can leave the platform, but there is no explicit documentation of a full, open-format data export or account-closure data portability feature for users. missing for 10: explicit full-account data export tooling, open-format (e.g. CSV/JSON) export guarantee, and independent confirmation of ease of complete data extraction/exit.
